name: Sightkick
author: fabiobergmann

sections.description:
Sightkick is a hosted SEO and AI-search service that researches, writes, scores and publishes articles for your site, then keeps them current. This plugin is the WordPress side of that connection.

What the plugin does

  • Creates each article as a native block post — headings, lists, tables, quotes and images as real Gutenberg blocks you can edit.
  • Downloads every image into your media library, sets the alt text and the featured image. No hot-linking.
  • Writes the SEO title, meta description, focus keyphrase and social image into Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress or The SEO Framework when one is active. Without an SEO plugin it renders the title, description, Open Graph tags and structured data itself.
  • Updates a published article in place when Sightkick refreshes it — same post, same URL.
  • Serves your IndexNow key file so search engines are told about new and updated URLs.
  • Only ever touches posts it created. Your existing posts are never modified.

How it connects

Install and activate the plugin, then open Settings → Sightkick and copy the token. In Sightkick, go to Settings → Integrations → WordPress, paste the token and your site address, pick a default author and category, and connect. The plugin never contacts sightkick.so on its own; Sightkick calls the plugin’s authenticated REST endpoint (/wp-json/sightkick/v1/) when it publishes or updates an article.

Service disclosure

This plugin is a connector for the Sightkick service (https://sightkick.so), which requires an account. Sightkick sends article content (text, image URLs, metadata) to your site and reads back the list of posts it created. Nothing else is transmitted. Terms of service: https://sightkick.so/terms · Privacy policy: https://sightkick.so/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Open Settings → Sightkick and copy the token.
  3. In Sightkick, open Settings → Integrations, choose WordPress, paste the token and your site address, and connect.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin change my existing posts?

No. It only creates new posts and updates the ones it created (they carry a hidden Sightkick article id).

Will it work with Yoast SEO / Rank Math / AIOSEO?

Yes. The plugin detects the active SEO plugin and writes the SEO title, meta description, focus keyphrase and social image into its fields. Their own structured data stays in charge; Sightkick adds only FAQ and list schema on top.

What if I use a page builder?

Articles are created as standard block posts. If your builder’s theme templates control single posts, they will render the post content as usual.

Is the token a secret?

Yes — anyone holding it can publish to your site. You can regenerate it under Settings → Sightkick, which disconnects Sightkick until you paste the new one.

Does the plugin send data to Sightkick?

No. All requests are inbound from the service; the plugin only responds to them. Uninstalling removes the plugin’s settings and leaves your posts and media in place.
